item.title: Ask HN: Are you interested in a TUI-style financial analysis tool?
item.summary: I found that popular Financial Terminals are overwhelmed by dashboards, data, news and predictions, but lack of some deep analysis. Also, these Financial tools are controlled by user clicks instead of command lines. Are you interested in a TUI-style financial analysis terminal which is controlled by command lines and provide deep analysis within seconds?
